model_inference: none; the real offline Pi process loads the package and handles its RPC command
runtime_boundary: Pi CLI, extension loading, lifecycle and widget-host feature paths are real; only provider inference is omitted.

assertions.expected: The actual Pi RPC command inventory includes widget-host:status

cases.name: reload_cleanup

assertions.expected: A second actual Pi process after disposal registers widget-host:status
The second actual Pi process handles the status command and returns the demo-provider feature result
assertions.observed:
